justification: Both depict human figures rendered in carved stone, but A is a three-dimensional composite sculpture of a squatting/kneeling figure with a large curved headdress or bird-like element above, while B is a flat rock-cut panel with a row of small standing figures beneath a winged/arched emblem above dense lines of inscription. Beyond the generic presence of human figures, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement; the framed relief-plus-text tableau of B has no counterpart in the free-standing stacked figure of A.
